SELECT b.*, c.name AS category_name FROM reader_book b LEFT JOIN reader_category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.scope = 'PUBLIC' AND b.status = 'VISIBLE'
AND b.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (LOWER(b.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{keyword})), '%') OR LOWER(b.author) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{keyword})), '%'))
ORDER BY b.updated_at DESC, b.id DESC
